neighbours.label: adjective-forming suffix split off as its own token, mainly '-less' and '-ish' (cloud|less, pink|ish); the suffix token fires
fire: We woke to a cloudless sky above the harbor.
The hikers crossed the ridge on a moonless night in October.
This variety is thornless and produces sweet berries by midsummer.
They found shelter in a roofless barn at the edge of the field.
The petals fade to a pinkish white as the flower ages.
The bird has a yellowish breast and dark wings.
A brownish stain spread across the old ceiling.
The cave led down to a sunless lake far below the surface.
quiet: We woke to a clear sky above the harbor.
The hikers crossed the ridge on a cold night in October.
This variety is hardy and produces sweet berries by midsummer.
They found shelter in a ruined barn at the edge of the field.
The petals fade to a pale white as the flower ages.
The bird has a yellow breast and dark wings.
A brown stain spread across the old ceiling.
The cave led down to a hidden lake far below the surface.

notes: Probes: -less and -ish on a split stem reach 0.33-0.46 of max; 'reddish' only 0.10, '-ic' 0.12, whole-token ' childish' 0.02. Tokenizer splits were checked for the fire words (no scoring).
